summary: Example using the template module to write a host's hostname fact into /tmp/hostname from templates/test.j2.
questions: Can you show a simple template module example?
How do I write a fact into a file with a template?

answer_card.title: Simple template example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Write hostname
  hosts: all
  tasks:
  - ansible.builtin.template:
      src: templates/test.j2
      dest: /tmp/hostname
```

`templates/test.j2`:

```jinja
My name is {{ ansible_facts['hostname'] }}
```
